tables.name: messages
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE messages(
  tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, received_at TEXT, ingested_at TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT,
  recipient_pseudo TEXT, text_redacted TEXT NOT NULL, language TEXT, variety TEXT, score REAL, verdict TEXT,
  analysis TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unspecified', PRIMARY KEY(tenant, id))

tables.name: indicators
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE indicators(
  tenant TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT, linkable INTEGER)

tables.name: investigations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE investigations(
  tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant, id))

tables.name: operations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE operations(
  ts TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT, op TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, duration_ms REAL, items INTEGER, detail TEXT)

tables.name: audit
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE audit(ts TEXT, tenant TEXT, action TEXT, detail TEXT)

tables.name: schema_meta
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE schema_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)

relations.description: each extracted indicator belongs to one message (same tenant); deleted with it
relations.description_ar: كل مؤشر مستخرج ينتمي إلى رسالة واحدة (من الحساب نفسه) ويُحذف معها

relations.description: campaigns are not stored: they are recomputed from indicators by the graph engine
relations.description_ar: الحملات لا تُخزَّن: يعيد محرك الرسم حسابها من المؤشرات عند كل تغيير

relations.description: append-only log of sensitive actions (exports, deletions)
relations.description_ar: سجل إلحاقي للإجراءات الحساسة (التصدير، الحذف، التحقيقات)

derived_views.name: campaigns
derived_views.note: messages linked by shared actor-controlled resources; recomputed when data changes, never persisted
derived_views.note_ar: رسائل يربطها مورد مشترك يتحكم به المهاجم؛ تُعاد حسابها عند تغيّر البيانات ولا تُخزَّن

derived_views.name: template_families
derived_views.note: near-duplicate texts (weak evidence); recomputed, never persisted
derived_views.note_ar: نصوص شبه متطابقة (دليل ضعيف)؛ تُعاد حسابها ولا تُخزَّن
